# Sources and licences

> **The specimen images listed below are not included in this repository.**
> They were consulted for layout and MRZ test vectors only;
> `specimens/specimens_truth.json` keeps the transcribed MRZ text. The
> Commons "public domain" tag on the two SA smart ID images is doubtful (South
> Africa's Copyright Act exempts only official legislative, administrative and
> legal texts), so treat them as reference, not as redistributable.

Every image under `specimens/` is an official or published **specimen** (fictional
holder). Nothing here comes from a dataset of real people's documents. Everything
under `synth/`, `camera/` and `video/` is generated by this directory's scripts
from invented data.

`specimens/specimens_truth.json` holds the MRZ text of the TD3 specimens (all
check digits verified) and the printed fields of the SA smart ID specimen.

## Looked for, not obtained

| Wanted | Where | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ZAF passport specimen, ZAF ID book / smart ID specimens, GBR passport specimen | PRADO, https://www.consilium.europa.eu/prado/en/ZAF/index.html and `/GBR/` | HTTP 403 to both curl and the fetch tool (bot protection). Not obtained. |
| UK "Angela Zoe UK Specimen" data page | gov.uk / Home Office: `specimen-passports-caseworker-guidance` (text only, no images); Home Office design system passport pattern pages (no images); National Archives "Reproduction of the British passport" PDF (no specimen) | Not obtained. HMPO's "Basic Passport Checks" PDF (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69257dcf2945773cf12dcfe6/2025_BasicPassportChecks_1.0.pdf) does show specimen data pages, but its last page reserves all rights ("No part of this document may be reproduced ... without the prior written permission of HM Passport Office"), so no image was extracted. A person can view it for layout reference. |
| ZAF passport specimen on Commons | Commons search "South African passport" | Only covers and a 1995 handwritten passport (`1995 South African Passport page 2 and 3.png`) — skipped: pre-MRZ, and it may be a real holder's document. |
| SA green ID book specimen | Commons, web | Nothing found that is a specimen. Synthesised only. |
| ICAO Doc 9303 PDFs | `https://www.icao.int/publications/Documents/9303_p4_cons_en.pdf` (old URL now 404); the series is listed at https://www.icao.int/publications/doc-series/doc-9303 | Not downloaded; the ICAO Part 4 example MRZ (`P<UTOERIKSSON<<ANNA<MARIA...`) is used as a check-digit test vector in `synth.py`. |

No Kaggle or other "real ID" datasets were consulted or downloaded.
